missing: The C atom reference chain (job 21662288) ran under the earlier unified ABACUS build 556aa49f074746909b9c02c862ac2faa08c145ed (SHA-256 6663de9c4857cf7d012aae06d06572ae5bbc79ca5236ac80d057d325175b1366); the archived software identity covers the solid production chain of the accepted endpoint.
The per-q GRID_RESULT_SUMMARY files remain on the production cluster; the archived campaign CSVs carry the accepted values and job identifiers.

The performance block records the slowest canonical-q response task of the accepted endpoint (the q7 pilot, 05:35:21 on 48 nodes) together with the head/wing and LibRPA q-averaged postprocessing walls, from sacct output captured live during the campaign and archived as a verbatim excerpt; no single wall clock exists for the full multi-q chain.

properties.label: RPA cohesive energy
properties.definition: E_coh = (2 E_atom - E_solid_RPA)/2 per C atom of the diamond primitive cell at a = 3.570 A, from the accepted 30^3 FD8 grid endpoint (job 21728235) and the FD8 Gamma-only C atom reference (job 21662288).

properties.label: C solid RPA correlation energy
properties.definition: RPA correlation energy of the two-atom diamond primitive cell from the q-averaged Delta-ST response (13 canonical q, analytic head/wing, 12 GreenX frequencies, 30^3 grid).

properties.label: C solid RPA total energy
properties.definition: E0 + EcRPA of the two-atom diamond primitive cell at the same endpoint.

properties.label: C atom RPA correlation energy
properties.definition: RPA correlation energy of the isolated C reference atom (20 A box, 135^3 grid, integer occupations, 16 frequencies).

properties.label: C atom RPA total energy
properties.definition: E0 + EcRPA of the isolated C reference atom.

source.runtime_provenance: Accepted 30^3 grid endpoint from LibRPA q-averaged job 21728235 on df_dcu; the response stage ran the q7 pilot (21728230) plus the remaining canonical-q jobs on 48 nodes each (12 frequencies x 4 k-point groups, 1 rank/node, 30 OpenMP threads); C atom reference from unified-campaign job 21662288.
